messages.subject: IBD analysis error
parts:
Dear all. 

I try to run the following command: 

ibd_results <- dartR::gl.ibd(genlight_obj_filtered , distance = 'propShared', permutations = 999, paircols=pop) 
# in pop I have info about 2 populations

Error in paircols == "pop" :
  comparison (1) is possible only for atomic and list types

Thanks for the support,
Marco
